WEATHER UPDATE | 24-HOUR PUBLIC WEATHER FORECAST
Issued at 4:00 AM, 04 July 2025

SYNOPSIS: At 3:00 AM today, the center of Tropical Depression "BISING" was estimated based on all available data at 200 km West Northwest of Calayan, Cagayan (19.7°N, 119.6°E) with maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h near the center and gustiness of up to 55 km/h. It is moving Southwestward at 20 km/h. Southwest Monsoon affecting Central and Southern Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao.

Forecast Weather Conditions

Area: Ilocos Norte and Babuyan Islands
Weather Condition: Rains with Gusty winds
Caused By: TD BISING
Impacts: Possible flooding or landslides due to moderate to heavy rains. Minimal to minor threat to lives and properties due to strong winds.

Area: Apayao, Kalinga, Abra, Batanes, and mainland Cagayan
Weather Condition: Cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms
Caused By: TD BISING
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides due to moderate to heavy rains

Area: Metro Manila, Pampanga, Tarlac, Bulacan, Zambales, Bataan, Cavite, Batangas, Occidental Mindoro, and the rest of Ilocos Region and Cordillera Administrative Region
Weather Condition: Occasional rains
Caused By: Southwest Monsoon
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides due to moderate to heavy rains

Area: Visayas, Dinagat Islands, Surigao del Norte, and the rest of Luzon
Weather Condition: Cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms
Caused By: Southwest Monsoon
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides due to moderate to at times heavy rains

Area: The rest of the country
Weather Condition: Partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms
Caused By: Southwest Monsoon
Impacts: Possible flash floods or landslides during severe thunderstorms

Forecast Wind and Coastal Water Conditions

Area: Northern Luzon
Wind Speed: Moderate to Strong
Wind Direction: Southwest to South
Coastal Waters: Moderate to Rough / (1.2 to 2.5 meters)

Area: The rest of the country
Wind Speed: Light to Moderate
Wind Direction: Southwest
Coastal Waters: Slight to Moderate / (0.6 to 2.1 meters)
